history.sg_progress: The Peacebuilding Support Office reviews project implementation twice a year to determine whether a project is on track. If a project has been off track for more than one reporting cycle, the relevant programme officer contacts the project’s managers to identify the problem and implement solutions. Typically, this results in the projects getting back on track by the third reporting cycle.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure that corrective action is taken in a timely manner to bring off-track projects back on track.
history.administration_response: During 2023, significant efforts were made to address any delays encountered in the previous year: of 47 projects reported as off-track in November 2022, only eight were reported as such in November 2023. Moreover, the Peacebuilding Fund commissioned independent guidance on project performance tracking that provides a list of recommended actions for funds’ recipients to bring off-track projects back on track. The guidance also notes that an examination of the current portfolio as at October 2023 showed that out of all the projects that had been off-track at some point during their lifespan, 48 per cent were back on-track within 6 months and 82 per cent were back on track, or on track with peacebuilding results, within 12 months. Thus, the portfolio has a very strong performance in shifting off-track projects back on track. Moreover, the share of off-track projects in 2023 constituted 16 per cent, which is lower than the 2020 result (21.5 per cent) referenced by the Board for this recommendation. Considering the risk- tolerant nature of the programme and the contexts in which the Peacebuilding Fund works, there will always be a certain proportion of projects that will be off- track. The Peacebuilding Fund’s focus, as demonstrated earlier, is that off-track projects are monitored and are mostly brought on track within 12 months. The Administration therefore requests closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that a more comprehensive plan has been established and the on-track rate has been raised, the Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
